name: Meeting Builder
description: Builds and maintains real Meeting notes from Outlook Calendar activity -- the real Hermes cron job behind this is meeting-capture-recurring (every 3 hours), running the meeting-capture Skill.

steps.name: Fetch Meetings
steps.description: Pulls new Outlook Calendar meetings since the last capture point.

steps.name: Resolve Meeting Folder
steps.description: Determines series vs. one-time occurrence and creates/reuses the meeting's own folder structure -- mirrors email-thread-capture's own resolve-then-create pattern, one folder per meeting/series.

steps.name: Build Attendees
steps.description: Creates/links a Person note for each real attendee, reusing the same Person-creation primitive as email capture, deduplicated against existing People.

steps.name: Link to Thread
steps.description: Cross-references the meeting against a matching email Thread when one exists.
